The quiet landmark...
To find le motel de la Falaise, you must keep your eyes open. Because, unlike his big sister, he is discreet. Nestled at the end of an alley, out of sight. Staying there means finding yourself in a bubble, surrounded by beauty and tranquility. Perched on the edge of the cliff, as its name suggests, this enchanting place invites you to fully enjoy the breathtaking sun layers. Comfortably installed in the rest areas, you won’t miss anything of the magnificent spectacle offered by the mountains, the St. Lawrence River and the vagaries of the tides. Want to move… Take the walking path which gives you access to the banks or you can discover the village by foot. You are only a few steps away .
